# Maurício Yokoyama Issei

**From uncertainty to specification. From specification to production.**

Software engineering, production architecture and AI agents.

> Home page, generated by scripts/home/gen-home.mjs. HTML: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/

For more than twenty years I take what was designed until production and I see that it continues to run.

## How I Work

- **Listen · Research · Study.** Almost everything starts with a question. Before I answer, I disassemble the question and study each part. Example: "How to remove manual labor from the team?" - Who will operate? (Runbook · Plant); What can fail? (Incidents · Logs); How do you know it works? (Accept · Metrics).
- **Synthesize · Learn.** Then I close the sources and explain from scratch. That's when I separate what I understood from what I just read. Summary: "I just automate what someone can operate, watch fail and measure."
- **Design · Build · Validate.** Drawing so someone else can operate. I build it in small steps, and the test says it's right. The gate of this site: build, mirrors /en/ in day, artifacts generated in day, global coherence of the site, performance budget.
- **Sustain · Orchestrar · Evolve.** In the crisis, time counts. With the team, first I stabilize, then I investigate the root cause. The cause becomes the next question. States of an incident: Open incident → Stabilized service → Found root cause.
- **Integrate · Teach · Share.** What I can explain, public. Teaching consolidates what I've learned. Example: [AI Agent Engineering](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/engenharia-agentes-ia), with ten principles: The LLM is a component, not the pilot; Determinism is invariant testable; Separate the Vitrine Brain; Deterministic-first; strict contracts across the border; Isolate epistemic layers; Embrace Open World; governs the budget with ledgers; Fail-closed governance; Explain, don't expose the number.

## My projects

From conception to operation. Projects that came out of the paper and that someone uses. In each one, I count the problem and the decisions I have made.
